def knownCost : List (Job P A) → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | .resolved _ c _ :: js => c + knownCost js
  | .hard _ :: js => knownCost js

def pending : List (Job P A) → Nat

  | .resolved _ _ _ :: js => pending js
  | .hard _ :: js => 1 + pending js

def run (solve : P → Nat → Option (Nat × A)) (b : Nat) : List (Job P A) → Receipt A
  | [] => ⟨some [], [], 0⟩
  | .resolved _ c a :: js =>
    let r := run solve b js
    ⟨r.answers.map ((c,a) :: ·), r.calls, r.visits+1⟩
  | .hard p :: js =>
    match solve p b with
    | none => ⟨none, [b], 1⟩
    | some x =>
      let r := run solve b js
      ⟨r.answers.map (x :: ·), b :: r.calls, r.visits+1⟩

def schedule (solve : P → Nat → Option (Nat × A)) (q : Nat)
    (js : List (Job P A)) : Receipt A :=
  if q < knownCost js + 2*pending js then ⟨none, [], 0⟩ else
    let r := run solve (allocated q js) js
    ⟨r.answers.bind (fun xs => if answerCost xs ≤ q then some xs else none),
      r.calls, r.visits⟩

    (h : accepted T color = true) :
    ∃ o, (probe T color).outputs = [o] ∧ o.sourceCuts.length = inputRank T color-1 ∧

theorem probe_model_work (T : Tree) (color : Nat → Nat) (hr : inputRank T color ≤ 4) :
    (meterGenerate T color (inputRank T color-1)).measured.work ≤
      initialCharge T+64*(cap (inputResource T)+6) := by
  let B := min (inputRank T color-1) ((leaves T).length-1)
  have hB : B ≤ 3 := by dsimp [B]; omega
  have hp : 2^(B+1) ≤ 16 := by
    have h := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (n := 2) (by decide) (show B+1 ≤ 4 by omega)
    exact h
  have hm : (B+1)*2^(B+1) ≤ 64 := Nat.mul_le_mul (show B+1 ≤ 4 by omega) hp
  have h := generate_work_bound T color (inputRank T color-1)
  change _ ≤ initialCharge T+(cap (inputResource T)+6)*(B+1)*2^(B+1) at h
  calc

    (hp : RMAF.partitionCheck (RMAF.leaves t) bs = true)
